sql_templates.description: Select improving sectors based on latest breadth and stage analysis.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_sector_data AS (
  SELECT
    sector,
    MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date
  FROM
    breadth.sector_daily
  GROUP BY
    sector
),
sector_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    s.sector,
    s.breadth_signal,
    m.stage2_pct
  FROM
    breadth.sector_daily s
    JOIN latest_sector_data l ON s.sector = l.sector AND s.snapshot_date = l.latest_date
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above m ON s.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
  WHERE
    s.change_5d >= 0 -- improvement in last 5 sessions
)
SELECT
  sa.sector,
  sa.breadth_signal,
  sa.stage2_pct
FROM
  sector_analysis sa
WHERE
  sa.stage2_pct > 20 -- active stage 2 participation
ORDER BY
  sa.stage2_pct DESC
LIMIT 5; -- concise table output
